verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a read API that returns faults and projects. A changelog entry also says Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data to keep it longer than Honeybadger's retention period. Together these give some first-party ways to get data out, but nothing evidences a complete, self-serve account export in stated open formats. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (errors, occurrences, uptime, check-ins, logs), explicit open export formats, replication details and destination (the entry is truncated), availability on all plans, and independent corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
